topic: What interference mitigation techniques are viable for overlapping service transmissions across geographically dispersed ground stations?
consensus_response: Viable techniques include rate-splitting, common message decoding, beamforming, and adaptive modulation. These methods mitigate interference by optimizing transmission parameters, enhancing spatial reuse, and minimizing cochannel interference. Integrating machine learning and Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access (NOMA) can further improve performance, increasing capacity and reducing latency.
reference_context: Interference mitigation is crucial in high-density environments, with techniques like rate-splitting and beamforming reducing multipath and cochannel interference, improving packet delivery probability.
